meta.description: Read comfortably in Arabic and English, with help on every difficult word.

home.greeting: What would you like to read?
home.emptyBody: Upload a PDF you already have, or pick something free from the open library.
home.dropHint: or drop a PDF anywhere on this page

library.title: Library
library.emptyBody: Books, papers and articles you add will appear here, with your progress.
library.removeBody: It leaves your library, along with your reading position. You can upload it again any time.
library.removeBodyNotes: It leaves your library, along with your reading position and {count, plural, one {# highlight, note or bookmark} other {# highlights, notes and bookmarks}}. This can't be undone.

explore.title: Explore
explore.soonTitle: The open library is on its way
explore.soonBody: Search across Project Gutenberg, DOAB, OpenAlex, arXiv and Arabic Collections Online, all free and openly licensed.

words.title: My Words
words.emptyBody: While reading, tap a marked word and choose “Save to my words”. It will appear here with the sentence you found it in.

auth.signInBody: Sign in to keep your library, notes and words in sync.
auth.checkEmail: Check your inbox — we sent you a sign-in link.
auth.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in isn’t configured yet. Add your Supabase keys to .env.local.

upload.dropTitle: Drop to add to your library
upload.panelDone: {count, plural, one {# file added} other {# files added}}
upload.scannedNote: Scanned pages: Reading mode and Smart Assist will need OCR (coming later). Original mode works.

errors.tooLarge: This file is larger than {max} MB.
errors.corrupt: This PDF looks damaged and can't be opened.
errors.network: Connection lost. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reader.noContents: This document has no table of contents.
reader.textError: The text of this document couldn't be loaded.
reader.preparingText: Preparing Reading mode… This takes a few seconds for long books.
reader.focusOn: Focus mode on. Move the mouse or tap to show the controls; press F to leave.
reader.readingNeedsText: This PDF is scanned images with no text, so only Original mode is available.
reader.garbledNote: The text in this PDF may come out jumbled.
reader.missingBody: It may have been removed, or the link belongs to someone else’s library.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Your highlights, notes and bookmarks in this document.
notes.empty: Select any text to highlight it or add a note. Everything you mark appears here.
notes.emptyBookmarks: Press B or the bookmark button to bookmark a page.
notes.saveFailed: That change couldn't be saved. Please try again.

search.label: Search in this document
search.noText: This document is scanned images, so there's no text to search.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Work anywhere in the reader except while typing.
